trigger.m105_required_action: freeze queue capacity, accumulator width/order, fill-drain and shared service-port contracts before a scheduled claim

microarchitecture.name: bounded bitmap source-key transpose
microarchitecture.group_key: partition-local source[3:0] concatenated with output block[2:0]
microarchitecture.weight_service_per_nonempty_key: three load slots then one event slot per set row
microarchitecture.event_storage: one presence bit and one direction bit at fixed address (bank,key,row); no linked-list pointer or row payload
microarchitecture.simultaneous_ports: one fill-bank bit set and one distinct drain-bank bit clear per cycle
microarchitecture.empty_window_policy: one control cycle and zero service tokens
microarchitecture.accepted_valid_policy: exact just-accepted event or close may remain asserted without reaccept; any identity mutation fails closed same cycle

accumulator_contract.loop_order: window-major across all 432 partitions before committing the 64-row output tile
accumulator_contract.banking: eight output-block banks, each updating 96 signed lanes
accumulator_contract.required_ports: one vector read plus one vector write per event cycle
accumulator_contract.conflict_argument: rows are unique within one key; consecutive keys rotate output block before the same block returns
accumulator_contract.still_required: bit-exact finite-width accumulator replay and target macro/RMW timing
